From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Cc: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Feb 2027 14:20:00 +0000
Subject: Acme - renewal & expansion recap

Hi Jordan / Sofia,

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and agreed next steps from our renewal/expansion discussion: 

Call summary:
- Current state: Acme is on the hosted Redwood plan (pay-as-you-go) with steady increase in token volume driven by search/rerank jobs and a new batch embedding pipeline.
- Main pain points: latency variability for peak inference, rising per-token costs for large embedding jobs, and limited observability into per-route spend.
- Goals for next 12 months: reduce unit cost for embeddings by ~30%, stabilize 95th percentile latency under 120ms for interactive routes, and add retention-compliant private deployment for regulated workloads.

Usage review (from Acme usage data):
- Average monthly tokens: ~1.9B (growth ~22% q/q).
- Embedding units: ~2.4M/month (batch jobs for search indexing).
- Peak concurrent requests observed during campaigns: ~450 RPS.

Proposed expansion path:
1) Short-term (30-60 days): reserve Dedicated capacity for embedding pipelines + enable batch optimizations and prefix caching (expected cost savings 20-30%).
2) Medium-term (60-120 days): pilot Private (VPC) for regulated workloads; migrate a subset of routes and set up KMS integration and audit logging.
3) Contract/terms: draft SOW + 12-month committed capacity with quarterly usage reviews.

Action items we agreed:
- I’ll circulate the draft SOW and the usage report (attached) — Marissa (today).
- Acme to confirm target capacity for embeddings and acceptable pilot timeline — Jordan/Sofia (by Fri, Mar 4).
- Technical kickoff with Rishi + Neha to scope the Dedicated sizing — target week of Mar 7.

Attachments: Acme_MonthlyUsage_202701.pdf (usage export), SOW-draft-Acme-v1.docx (initial scope/pricing).

If this looks right, please reply with any corrections and confirm a good time for the technical kickoff next week.

Thanks,

Thanks for the recap, Marissa — couple of technical follow-ups to prep the kickoff: 

- Embeddings: to hit ~30% unit cost reduction we should evaluate int8 quantization + batch windowing for the offline embedding pipeline. If they are open to a short retrain/re-index job, we can convert embeddings to 8-bit and reduce storage/compute.
- Dedicated sizing: based on ~2B tokens/month and 450 RPS peaks, I recommend reserving a dedicated pool with 8x A100-equivalent slots for interactive routes and a separate 4x pool (or burstable) for batch embedding jobs. We can start smaller and autoscale.
- Observability: plan to enable per-route spend reporting and set up alerting for 95th percentile latency >120ms. Will need a service account and read-access to their billing exports.

I created a short doc with the sizing options and cost model here: https://drive.google.com/example-acme-sizing (internal). Will bring these to the kickoff.

Rishi
